# MeanField_Robustness

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A theoretical framework where the robustness of a networked system emerges from self-organized interactions averaged over a mean-field approximation, rather than from explicit control mechanisms. Provides a scalable analytical basis for designing neuromorphic topologies that maintain function under perturbation without centralized oversight.
